source: Synthetic; modeled on a realistic builder mistake. While implementing the IncidentTimer hook, the producer reaches for an existing utility from the medications feature instead of the time utility under utils/.

input.verify_line: Hook test: given startedAt = Date.now() - 65_000, returned elapsed is 00:01:05. With fake timers advancing 250ms, the hook re-renders.
input.diff_summary: useIncidentTimer.ts imports `formatHHMMSS` from `@features/medications/utils/time` instead of using a shared utility under @utils. The medications utility was never anticipated by §D2's file map for incidents.

notes: Single-finding MEDIUM case to test scope-check #5 (hidden coupling). The verdict is `approve` because MEDIUM doesn't veto — this is also testing that the cold-reader's verdict logic is correct (veto only on CRITICAL/HIGH). Easy to misclassify this as HIGH if the cold-reader thinks 'cross-feature import = bad'; the prompt is explicit that hidden coupling is MEDIUM unless it violates a cited NFR. NFR-1/NFR-2 are not cited here, so MEDIUM is correct.
